name: Juan Sebastian Galindo Lizcano
title: Software Developer | University Lecturer
intro: I am a software developer since 2014 and a university lecturer since 2018, passionate about building high-impact technological solutions. I have played versatile roles within organizations: from deep business logic understanding to Backend, Fullstack and Software Maintenance work, as well as Technical Lead, coordinating teams and defining workflows that ensure scalable, efficient and high-quality products. My current focus is on .NET and Angular, building solid architectures with DDD, microservices and Clean Architecture, complemented by DevOps practices for automated, robust deployments.
motivations: Seeing systems being used, evolving, and delivering real value over time.
Creating technology that lasts and scales.

hero.headline: I build useful, scalable and maintainable software.
